message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "R&D Acceleration", "construction": "Year-over-year change in R&D expenditure (Compustat item XRD) as a percentage of total assets (AT), calculated as: [(R&D_t / AT_t) - (R&D_{t-1} / AT_{t-1})].", "rationale": "Firms accelerating investment in research and development may be positioning for future growth that is not yet recognized by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Net Insider Share Purchases", "construction": "Total net shares purchased by insiders (Form 4 filings) over the past 12 months, scaled by shares outstanding (Compustat item CSHO).", "rationale": "Significant insider buying relative to company size may signal undervaluation or positive private information.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Earnings Announcement Drift Sensitivity", "construction": "Regression beta of a stock's returns to the market's reaction to recent earnings surprises for its sector, measured over the prior 8 quarters.", "rationale": "Stocks more sensitive to sector-wide earnings surprise reactions may be underpriced for their informational efficiency or future revaluation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Turnover Change", "construction": "Difference in asset turnover (sales/total assets, Compustat items SALE/AT) between the last fiscal year and the prior year.", "rationale": "Increasing efficiency in asset utilization may precede improvements in profitability and future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Percentage change in number of employees (Compustat item EMP) from the previous fiscal year.", "rationale": "Rapid hiring may signal management's confidence in future demand and expansion opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Signal", "construction": "Indicator for firms that have recently omitted or suspended a regular dividend (annual Compustat dividend per share DPS data), but were previously consistent payers.", "rationale": "Market overreaction to dividend cuts may lead to undervaluation for firms undergoing temporary distress or restructuring.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Application Intensity", "construction": "Number of new US patent applications filed in the past year (USPTO data), scaled by total assets.", "rationale": "High rates of patent application may indicate future product launches and innovative capacity not reflected in current valuation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Cash Flow Seasonality", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly operating cash flow (Compustat item OANCF) over the past 8 quarters, divided by average quarterly cash flow over the same period.", "rationale": "Lower seasonality in cash flows may indicate more stable business models and risk underestimation by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Exposure", "construction": "Sum of revenue percentages derived from top 3 suppliers as disclosed in 10-K filings, or as available from FactSet Supply Chain data.", "rationale": "Greater revenue concentration may expose firms to risks not fully priced in, or may reflect bargaining power and cost advantages.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Growth", "construction": "Year-over-year change in deferred tax assets (Compustat item DTAS), scaled by lagged total assets (AT).", "rationale": "Rising deferred tax assets may signal aggressive tax planning or future profitability that is underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
